description: List glue records for a domain. Glue records associate a host (e.g. `ns1.example.com`) with one or more IP addresses at the registry, used when running your own nameservers on the same domain they serve. Read `glue` in the response: one `{host, v4, v6}` object per host, both address lists always present (empty when none), and an empty array when there is no glue. `hosts` carries the same data as `[hostname, {v4, v6}]` pairs for older clients.

domain.description: Domain to list glue records for, e.g. `example.com`

name: list_glue_records
title: List Glue Records
